body.heading: Where in the world is Venezuela?
paragraphs: Venezuela is a country in South America.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Venezuela is Caracas.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Venezuela is Spanish.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Venezuela is the Venezuelan bolívar.

body.heading: How big is Venezuela?
paragraphs: Venezuela covers about 916,000 square kilometres of land and inland water.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Angel Falls is the tallest waterfall on Earth — water free-falls 807 metres from a tepui cliff in Canaima National Park before dissolving into mist.
Los Roques is a national park of coral cays and lagoons in every shade of blue — Venezuela's Caribbean paradise for boats and beaches.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Venezuela on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?

takeaway: Venezuela in one breath: a country in South America, capital Caracas, where people speak Spanish and pay with the Venezuelan bolívar.
materials: A globe, atlas or world map (to find Venezuela)
Paper and crayons or pencils for the screen-free mission
supervision: Independent reading for confident readers; the Think and talk questions about Venezuela make a good family discussion afterwards.
safetyNotes: Reading only — no physical activity is involved.
If your family ever visits the watery places in this article, water fun in Venezuela always needs a grown-up watching closely.
screenFreeExtension: Screen-free mission: find Venezuela on a map or globe, say its capital out loud, then draw the place you'd most love to visit there.
